text: {"lessons":["Buying in stages gave me exposure without committing all my cash at once; I should continue to size purchases carefully and keep liquidity for future contributions or needs.","My account fell after reaching a high, reminding me that short-term gains can reverse; I should avoid reacting impulsively to monthly swings.","I want to buy an apartment within ten years, so I should review my progress and risk level against that goal rather than trade frequently just because I check my account often."]}
